items.title: Regularity of the local rings of a scheme over a local ring and of its base change to the completion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves three statements comparing regularity of the local rings of a locally finite type scheme over a Noetherian local ring with those of its base change to the completion: one implication holds always, the two conditions are equivalent at points of the closed fibre, and for a proper morphism the two schemes are simultaneously regular (statement lines 2996-3010). The proof (proof lines 3011-3026) descends regularity along the flat base change, compares complete local rings, and uses properness to restrict to closed points. H3: three assertions from three distinct inputs.
